name: Tsukimizaka Kiriha
source:
Hobbies: Singing karaoke alone
Likes: Acting out characters, parfaits
Dislikes: Herself, flattery, dogs

A popular seiyuu working under the alias Tsukimi Kirina who is part of the seiyuu department at Saika Private Academy. She is affiliated with the Rain Tears agency.

Kiriha has a cheerful personality and a bright smile, and she is loved by everyone around her. Despite this, her calm demeanor doesn't match her appearance. Is she truly the embodiment of the ideal woman, or is there more to her that meets the eye...?

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
